clock-elapsed.text: The clock will show time in session.

clock-wall.text: The clock will show the time of day.

help.text: Say begin to start, or customize the session by naming a vibe, a focus, or a length of time.

tour-done.text: You can also use the setup screen by talking naturally. For example, say 'twenty minutes' and I'll set a timer. Or, say 'begin' to start a session. Now you're ready to give it a try.

tour-exploration.text: Exploration is a conversation. Close your eyes and speak a sentence or two about a sensation or feeling you're experiencing, and I'll ask short questions to help you explore.

tour-felt-sense.text: Felt sense follows a six step process where you'll investigate something that's on your mind by putting it into words and feeling into your body's responses, in order to get to the root of it.

tour-focus.text: Back to Exploration, which is the best place to start. Choosing a focus tells me where you plan to put your attention: the body, emotions, or parts of yourself. Or leave it blank if you aren't sure.

tour-hello.text: Welcome to aloud, the meditation app that speaks and listens. Turn on the microphone and you can answer me out loud.

tour-noting.text: Noting is simple. With a word or two, name something you're noticing in the moment, like warmth or relaxation or thinking. You can add sounds or virtual participants to keep the pace between turns.

tour-vibe.text: Vibes set the tone of the session. Playful, spacious, compassionate, or any mix you like.

tour-voice-control.text: By the way, you can say 'back' or 'next' to control this tour.

tour-voice-picked.text: Good. There are more voices in the voice picker whenever you like.

voice-intro-first.text: Hi, I'm Ethan. This is how I sound.

voice-intro-second.text: And I'm Ethan. Say which of us you'd like, or tap our name.

help.text: 说“开始”就可以开始，也可以说出氛围、焦点或时长来定制这次冥想。

tour-done.text: 你也可以用自然的说话来操作设置页面。比如说“二十分钟”，我就会设好计时。或者说“开始”，就能开始冥想。现在可以试试看了。

tour-exploration.text: 探索是一场对话。闭上眼睛，用一两句话说说你此刻的身体感觉或情绪，我会用简短的问题陪你探索。

tour-felt-sense.text: 体会分六步：把心里的那件事说出来，再去感受身体的反应，借此探究它，找到它的根源。

tour-focus.text: 回到探索，这是最适合开始的地方。选一个焦点，就是告诉我你打算把注意力放在哪里：身体、情绪，或内在的各个部分。也可以不选。

tour-hello.text: 欢迎来到 aloud，一款会说也会听的冥想应用。打开麦克风，你就可以直接开口回答我。

tour-noting.text: 标记很简单。用一两个词说出你此刻注意到的，比如温暖、放松或思考。还可以加入音效或虚拟参与者，在你开口的间隙保持节奏。

tour-vibe.text: 氛围决定这次冥想的基调。轻松有玩心、开阔、慈悲，可以随意搭配。

tour-voice-control.text: 顺便说一下，你可以说“上一步”或“下一步”来控制这个导览。

tour-voice-picked.text: 好的。以后随时可以在声音选择里换别的声音。

voice-intro-first.text: 你好，我是 Serena。这是我的声音。

voice-intro-second.text: 我是 Serena。想听谁的声音？说出名字，或者点一下我们的名字。
